name: Ja'far ibn Ulba al-Harithi
bio: Ja'far was a horseman of Banu al-Harith ibn Ka'b who lived in Najran across the change from Umayyad to Abbasid rule. A handful of his pieces survive, several in the opening section of Abu Tammam’s Hamasa. Al-Zirikli says he was accused of taking part in the killing of Khushayna of Uqayl. Accounts differ about who carried out the retaliation. He was put to death in 145 AH (762 CE).
